**Physics/Electronics Formula**:
For a standard step-up chopper (Boost converter), the relationship between output voltage ($V_{out}$) and input voltage ($V_{in}$) is given by:
$$V_{out} = \frac{V_{in}}{1 - D}$$

$$4 \div 15 \approx 0.2666...$$
